# modal-spaces data import

This folder contains a first example dataset imported from the `modal-spaces` research project.

Source repository:
- https://github.com/PhilLaboratory/modal-spaces

Imported files:
- `data/*.csv` — Qualtrics study datasets for Studies 1a–6
- `materials/contextsTable.csv` — scenario context descriptions and options
- `materials/actualActions.csv` — action choice annotations
- `manualCoding/textsCodingKey.csv` — coding key for free-response text annotations

Purpose:
- Provide a concrete starting dataset for `Modal thought`
- Let us build an interactive data explorer from real experimental data
- Preserve the source context while keeping this project self-contained

Notes:
- The import is intentionally limited to core data and metadata files.
- The original `modal-spaces` repository also contains analyses, figures, and notebooks.
